source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the stick seen from behind-left (pilot's view) and above, head buttons toward the camera, palm rest to the right
mappingSource: catalog (thrustmaster.json, confidence low: "Vibration version of the Fox 2 Pro (same shell); numbering not published -> controls without input"). Same shell as the Fox 2 Pro, whose FlightGear map comments (https://gitlab.com/flightgear/fgdata/-/blob/next/Input/Joysticks/ThrustMaster/Top-Gun-Fox2-Pro-USB.xml) place: trigger, striped button, side button above the trigger, right button next to the striped one, three bottom (base) buttons; Thrustmaster's support page has no manual
note: The three "Head button" parts are interchangeable in the catalog (no input numbers); thumb.1 = striped button, thumb.2 = right wedge, thumb.3 = side button above the trigger, assigned by JoyPro only. Base buttons and throttle slider not identifiable for certain: dark recesses under the orange/white scale at the base front are kept as hidden candidates for the base buttons; the throttle slider is not identified on this photo. Caution: the orange-to-white scale with the recesses under it may instead be the throttle slider running in an arc slot (the scale reads like a throttle gauge), so a reviewer should check a real device or another photo before showing any of these.
